ارتهنتم (form VIII)
# اِرْتَهَنْتُمْ (irtahantum) /ir.ta.han.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
# اُرْتُهِنْتُمْ (urtuhintum) /ur.tu.hin.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
